headline: ForbeniusNorm surges from 635th to 49th on ARC-3

sections.text: ForbeniusNorm gained 5.19 points to reach 35.81, vaulting from 635th to 49th on the public ARC-AGI-3 board.
The jump carries ForbeniusNorm into a prominent position on the ARC-3 board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
